status: Frozen before transfer/coherence results or new model controls. Complete original source spectra/RMS informed interval selection, not candidate error.
target: Feasibility of cancellation of source phase/performance in L-to-R and Mid-to-Side transfer. No reverb topology or parameter fitting.
estimator: H1 = mean(conj(X)*Y) / mean(abs(X)^2); MSC = abs(mean(conj(X)*Y))^2 / (mean(abs(X)^2)*mean(abs(Y)^2)). Periodic Hann, 75% overlap, no detrending or padding. X=L,Y=R, or X=(L+R)/2,Y=(L-R)/2.
guard_policy: Report excited-bin counts and weighted coherence before selecting coherent bins. Both X/Y power must exceed -50 dB relative to their respective 80-8k maxima; SM also requires side/mid >= -35 dB. Stability/error uses common eligible bins and reports lost coverage. Overlapping frames are not independent trials.

model_controls.routing: Actual current engine, exact original delay/reverb blocks and sends. Single centered EXT-IN, filter bypass, no overdrive, constant AMP. Input HPF/startup remain; exclude first 4 seconds. No FX implementation changes.
model_controls.chord: C3/E3/G3 harmonics to 8 kHz with phases 0.37*h*h or 0.91*h*h. These are diagnostic inputs, not recovered original notes.
model_controls.impulse_truth: Cotton impulses start after 4 or 12 seconds of silence. Fold the complete remaining response modulo each FFT size before FFT, evaluating exact transfer at estimator bins. Common input-filter response and phase cancel in L/R and S/M ratios. Require terminal 1 s power at least 100 dB below full response before accepting this finite-response control.
model_controls.time_invariance: Compare the two Cotton impulse launch times without a phase search or candidate.

source_scope: Driven musical passages have changing notes, not authenticated stationary stochastic inputs. Tails are excluded. All window sizes retain the same intervals; insufficient-frame results are flagged.
cotton_channel_sensitivity: Raw primary; separately divide R by 10^(.6/20), fixed from the earlier pre-return channel-gain observation. No new gain, phase or capture fit.
truth_error: Complex relative error, magnitude and phase difference to Cotton impulse truth, with excited/coherent/common coverage counts. Compare independent white and phase-varied chord inputs.
synthetic_controls: Known two-tap stereo FIR with two independent white inputs, compared with exact response.
Independent L/R noise as a negative coherence control.
qualifications: Original controller, patch revision and capture state are unknown.
Current Cotton mono/LTI behavior does not prove original topology.
Air/Supa/Class A have active modulated delay.
Finite-window convolution leakage and preexisting network state can prevent source cancellation.
High L/R coherence may reflect dominant dry mono; Mid/Side requires adequate side energy and coherence.
No single-frame coherence or complete-recording Fourier ratio is accepted without separate checks.
